item.question: How does the von Mises-Fisher distribution affect scatterer behavior in wireless channels?
item.answer: The von Mises-Fisher distribution describes the orientation and concentration of scatterers around a mean direction. This affects how signals are scattered, influencing their Doppler spectrum characteristics depending on whether antenna motion is parallel or perpendicular to this mean direction.
